aiReview.summary: Official Google Skills intermediate course on Gemini, Streamlit, and Cloud Run. It is a human lab/badge path, not an installable agent skill pack, so it is a weak fit for a skills-focused directory.
evidence: Canonical URL is a Google Skills course template (paths/236/course_templates/978).
Meta description and body cover Gemini prompting, function calls, Streamlit, Docker, and Cloud Run.
Rubric prefers agent skill packs over course landing pages.
uncertainty: Exact pricing and whether labs are free without a Skills subscription.
Full lab module list beyond the marketing description.
Whether challenge-lab content is accessible without prior course progress.
aiReview.tagline: Hands-on Gemini, Streamlit, and Cloud Run labs
aiReview.description: Learn Gemini prompting, Python SDK function calls, and deploying Streamlit apps as Docker containers on Cloud Run in an intermediate skill-badge course.
pros: Hosted on Google Skills with a stated intermediate skill-badge course and challenge lab.
Described scope includes text generation, Gemini API function calling with the Python SDK, Cloud Shell testing, and Cloud Run deployment.
Page lists a short duration (45 minutes) and a recent update timestamp.
cons: This is a course landing page, not a SKILL.md pack or CLI agent skill directory.
Hands-on labs typically require a Google Skills account and may not be freely usable without credits or a subscription.
No agent-installable skill files, prompts, or maintenance repo are provided on the page.
